nodes.title: SG-3.3 · Unit tests with mocked dependencies for the App flow
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/App.tsx composes IntroScreen, GameLayout, SceneView, ActionMenu and StoryPanel on top of useGame, which persists state through runtime/storage (readSaved/writeSaved). tests/app.test.tsx already renders the real stack with jsdom localStorage and covers the intro gate and basic clicks. Desired behavior: a dedicated App flow test file in which the storage dependency is replaced by an in-memory fake and the three flows are asserted. Expected result: green, fast unit tests proving the click-to-menu, action/choice-to-story and remount-restore flows. Why: guard the playable loop against regressions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the App is begun, when a hotspot is clicked, then the action menu for that object shows its description and action buttons
- Given the action menu is open, when an action is chosen, then the story history shows the action's text
- Given the opening dialogue, when a choice is clicked, then the dialogue closes and history records the choice text
- Given a state saved through the mocked storage, when App is unmounted and remounted and Begin is clicked, then the saved story and open-door state are restored


## Scope
- In scope: New App flow unit test file with a mocked runtime/storage module
- In scope: Minimal accessibility seams in ActionMenu and StoryPanel needed by the tests
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Browser or e2e tests
- Out of scope: Persisting the intro-gate state
- Preserve: Existing tests/app.test.tsx behavior
- Preserve: useGame and storage public signatures
- Preserve: Hotspot data-open semantics


## Technical constraints
- Vitest + @testing-library/react in jsdom, as configured in game/frontend/vitest.config.ts
- Dependencies mocked with vi.mock; no real network or browser


## Definition of done
- All three flows covered by passing unit tests
- Typecheck passes


## Non-functional requirements
- Tests finish in seconds


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Clicking an object opens its action menu
nodes.body:
Context: App holds selectedId and renders ActionMenu for the selected SceneObjectView. Desired behavior: the menu section carries the object id so the flow is assertable without relying on text. Expected result: clicking Bookshelf shows its menu with Inspect, Push, Search, Leave. Why: the entry point to all interactions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the playing view, when Bookshelf is clicked, then a region named Bookshelf contains Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons
- Given no hotspot is selected, when the view renders, then no action menu region exists


## Scope
- In scope: ActionMenu root attribute data-object-id
- Out of scope: Menu styling
- Preserve: ActionMenu props
- Preserve: aria-label equal to object name


## Technical constraints
- Do not change ActionMenuProps


## Definition of done
- ActionMenu root exposes data-object-id


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Actions and dialogue choices update the story
nodes.body:
Context: useGame.act and useGame.choose update state, which StoryPanel renders via getActiveNode and history. Desired behavior: the dialogue section is a named region so tests can assert it closes after a choice. Expected result: Search adds the hidden door text; choosing a dialogue option closes the dialogue and records it. Why: core story loop.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the Bookshelf menu, when Search is clicked, then the Story history list contains 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.'
- Given the opening dialogue, when 'Look around the room' is clicked, then the Dialogue region disappears and history contains that text


## Scope
- In scope: StoryPanel dialogue section aria-label
- Out of scope: Dialogue content changes
- Preserve: StoryPanel props
- Preserve: Choice button labels


## Technical constraints
- Do not change StoryPanelProps


## Definition of done
- Dialogue section exposes accessible name Dialogue

- None

nodes.title: REQ · Remount restores the saved game state
nodes.body:
Context: useGame initialises from readSaved() and writes on every state change; the intro gate (begun) is local state and resets on remount. Desired behavior: the inventory region is named so restored inventory is assertable alongside history and hotspot state. Expected result: with storage mocked in memory, state survives remount. Why: players must not lose progress.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given Search was performed and storage is the in-memory mock, when App is remounted and Begin clicked, then history shows the hidden door text and Bookshelf has data-open true
- Given the mocked readSaved returns null, when App renders and Begin is clicked, then the opening dialogue is shown


## Scope
- In scope: StoryPanel inventory section aria-label
- Out of scope: Persisting intro gate
- Preserve: STORAGE_KEY
- Preserve: readSaved/writeSaved signatures


## Technical constraints
- Do not change runtime/storage.ts


## Definition of done
- Inventory section exposes accessible name Inventory


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: Unit tests for hotspot-to-menu flow with mocked storage
nodes.description: Write tests/appFlow.test.tsx with an in-memory mock of runtime/storage and assert the menu flow.
acceptance_criteria: Given Begin clicked, when Bookshelf clicked, then region Bookshelf has data-object-id bookshelf and four action buttons
Given Begin clicked and nothing selected, then no region named Bookshelf exists
definition_of_done: Tests pass with the command below

steps.symbol: new: storage mock + describe('App flow: action menu')
steps.action: Create the file with '// @vitest-environment jsdom', and vi.mock('../src/runtime/storage') factory whose readSaved returns a module-level `saved` variable (initially null) and writeSaved assigns `saved = state` and returns true; add beforeEach resetting saved to null and afterEach(cleanup). Add helper begin() that renders <App/> and clicks the Begin button.
steps.code:
let saved: unknown = null;
vi.mock('../src/runtime/storage', () => ({ readSaved: () => saved, writeSaved: (s: unknown) => { saved = s; return true; } }));
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'action menu'
steps.expected: File is collected with the mock active.

steps.symbol: it('opens the Bookshelf menu on hotspot click')
steps.action: Call begin(); assert screen.queryByRole('region',{name:'Bookshelf'}) is null; click button 'Bookshelf'; assert the region named 'Bookshelf' has attribute data-object-id='bookshelf' and within it buttons Inspect, Push, Search, Leave exist.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'action menu'
